name: The Brawl School
summary: Commander with 60 cards and the Standard pool. Fast duels, planeswalker commanders.
text: Brawl takes Commander's best idea, a commander you can always cast, and makes it quick: 60 cards, one of each, only Standard cards, and 25 life in a duel. Planeswalkers can lead too. You'll learn the rules, the four roles, how to play a planeswalker commander, and the commanders people play today.

chapters.name: First steps
chapters.text: Brawl is Commander made small: a 60-card deck led by a legendary creature or a planeswalker, one copy of each card, and only cards legal in Standard. Duels start at 25 life and move fast.

nodes.name: Boss Nubb
nodes.text: A goblin foreman who never stops hiring.

lesson.title: Sixty cards, one of each
lesson.text: A Brawl deck is exactly 60 cards: your commander plus 59 others, one copy of each except basic lands. Every card must be legal in Standard and fit your commander's colour identity: Ruby is red and green, so no white, blue or black. Duels start at 25 life. Nubb's commander is Krenko, Mob Boss; yours is Ruby.

tips.title: The command zone
tips.text: Ruby starts in the command zone, not in your library. You can cast it from there any time you could cast a creature.

tips.title: Ruby on turn two
tips.text: Ruby costs two and has haste. Cast it now and attack; it gets +2/+2 when it attacks beside a creature with power 4 or more.

tips.title: Kill the boss
tips.text: Krenko makes a Goblin for every Goblin he controls each time he taps. Burn or fight it before it untaps.

nodes.before: More goblins, more problems. For you.

nodes.name: Mother Purr
nodes.text: Her cats answer to one great cat.

lesson.title: Commander tax
lesson.text: When your commander would die or be exiled, you can send it back to the command zone. Each time you cast it from there, it costs 2 more than the last time. Ruby is cheap, so trading it is fine when it buys something. Her commander, Arahbo, makes every cat bigger: kill it and make her pay the tax.

tips.title: Her engine
tips.text: Arahbo gives her other cats +1/+1 and makes a cat whenever a cat enters. Fiery Annihilation or Bite Down it now; next time it costs her 2 more.

tips.title: Paying the tax
tips.text: Every time Ruby comes back from the command zone it costs 2 more. Recast it with spare mana, not instead of your best spell.

tips.title: Count her cats
tips.text: Her cats get bigger together. Below 12 life, count her whole team's power before you attack with your blockers.

nodes.before: My kittens have claws. Lots of them.

nodes.name: Haste from the command zone
nodes.text: Your opponent is at 6 life behind a 0/5 Aegis Turtle. Ruby, Daring Tracker is in your hand, standing in for the command zone. Win this turn.
nodes.hint: Cast Ruby with the Mountain and a Forest. Attack with Ruby and Elfsworn Giant, then cast Giant Growth on whichever isn't blocked.

lesson.title: Haste and a big friend
lesson.text: Ruby has haste, so it attacks the turn it arrives, and it gets +2/+2 when it attacks while you control a creature with power 4 or more. Your commander is always available, so plan turns around it.

nodes.name: Elder Thessaly
nodes.text: The elf court has grown for a hundred years.

lesson.title: Commanders that snowball
lesson.text: Lathril makes an Elf for each point of combat damage it deals, and Elvish Archdruid turns Elves into mana. Lathril has menace, so it needs two blockers; burning it is easier. Thessaly starts at 30 life: attack with your big creatures while her Elves are still small.

tips.title: Menace
tips.text: Lathril can't be blocked except by two or more creatures. Kill it, or keep two blockers home.

tips.title: The mana elf
tips.text: Elvish Archdruid makes a green mana for each Elf she has and pumps them all. Burst Lightning or Abrade it before it untaps.

tips.title: Halfway there
tips.text: She's halfway down from 30. Keep attacking with your biggest creatures and use tricks to win the fights.

nodes.before: My court is old, child. Older than your ambition.

chapters.name: Archetypes
chapters.text: A commander tells you what the deck wants to do. Four loaner commanders, four roles: aggro, midrange, control and combo. Each duel asks one question: who's the beatdown?

nodes.name: Captain Merrow
nodes.text: Every land she plays draws her a card.

lesson.title: Race the value
lesson.text: Alesha attacks every turn, gets a +1/+1 counter each time, and with raid brings back a small creature from your graveyard at your end step. Tatyova draws Merrow a card for every land, so the longer the game, the more she has. Race: attack first, count damage, and spend removal on blockers or on Koma.

tips.title: Attack first
tips.text: Raid cards and Alesha's return ability need you to have attacked this turn. Attack, then cast Gorehorn Raider after combat.

tips.title: Don't fight Koma
tips.text: Koma can't be countered and has ward 4. Chump-block it and keep racing; you can't out-value it.

tips.title: Reach
tips.text: Count your burn and drain: Exsanguinate, Boltwave and Lightning Strike can finish the last points.

nodes.before: The tide brings me everything eventually.
nodes.after: You came faster than the tide.

nodes.name: Marigold Stitch
nodes.text: Her toys are small, many and sharp.

lesson.title: Stabilise, then turn
lesson.text: Arabella drains you each time it attacks, once for each of her creatures with power 2 or less. You're the bigger deck: block early, trade, and save removal for Arabella. Kutzil stops her casting spells on your turn, so once you're ahead you can attack without fearing tricks.

tips.title: The doll
tips.text: Each attack drains you for every small creature she has. Stroke of Midnight or Banishing Light it; recasting costs her 2 more.

tips.title: Trade early
tips.text: Her creatures are small. Block with anything that survives or trades; every creature she loses shrinks Arabella's drain.

tips.title: Turn the corner later
tips.text: Below 12, stop attacking with creatures you need as blockers until her board is smaller than yours.

nodes.before: Want to play with my toys? They want to play with you.
nodes.after: Back in the box, all of you.

nodes.name: The trading post
nodes.text: A collector offers a trade for your spare cards.

nodes.name: Old Hollin
nodes.text: Two rangers, one commander, no retreat.

lesson.title: Control in a singleton deck
lesson.text: With one copy of each card, you can't count on drawing your best removal, so count your answers: Hero's Downfall, Murder, Heartless Act, Bake into a Pie and more. Save them for Halana and Alena and the dragons, counter big spells, and let small creatures hit you. Talion flies over the ground once the board is clear.

tips.title: The partners
tips.text: Every combat they put counters on another creature and give it haste. Kill them now; each recast costs him 2 more.

tips.title: Counter or not
tips.text: Counter the spells that would beat you on their own: dragons, Etali, the commander. Let small creatures resolve and block them.

tips.title: Pick a number
tips.text: Talion punishes spells with the chosen mana value, power or toughness. Pick a number his deck plays often, like 4 or 5.

nodes.before: We hunt together. You'll fall together.
nodes.after: Clever. We'll track you another day.

nodes.name: Sunblade Corra
nodes.text: She discards her hand to swing harder.

lesson.title: Build the engine
lesson.text: Niv-Mizzet draws you a card for each point of noncombat damage you deal her, so Firebrand Archer, Guttersnipe and every burn spell also draw cards. Goldfish: build the engine, keep Niv out of combat, and point burn at her face once Niv is out. Hidetsugu's Second Rite wins on the spot at exactly 10 life. Burn her creatures only when it keeps you alive.

tips.title: Engine online
tips.text: Every ping is now cards. Cast cheap burn at her face, then use the cards you draw to find more.

tips.title: Exactly ten
tips.text: Hidetsugu's Second Rite deals 10 if she's at exactly 10. Ping her down to 10 first, then cast it.

tips.title: Buy a turn
tips.text: At low life, burn the biggest attacker. Interact only when it keeps you alive another turn.

nodes.before: I don't need cards in hand. I need you in front of me.
nodes.after: You drew more than I could burn.

chapters.name: Planeswalker commanders
chapters.text: Brawl lets a planeswalker be your commander. It sits on the battlefield, uses one loyalty ability a turn, and can be attacked. When it dies it goes back to the command zone, and it costs 2 more each time you recast it.

nodes.name: One ability a turn
nodes.text: Your opponent is at 10 life behind three creatures, one with reach. Elspeth, Storm Slayer has 5 loyalty. Win this turn.
nodes.hint: Stroke of Midnight on Treetop Snarespinner first. Then use Elspeth's 0 ability and attack with everything in the air.

lesson.title: Choose the ability that wins
lesson.text: A planeswalker uses one loyalty ability per turn, at sorcery speed. Elspeth's 0 gives each of your creatures a +1/+1 counter and flying; her -3 destroys a creature with mana value 3 or more. Pick the one that wins now, and clear the only creature that can block flyers first.

nodes.name: Skyward Ilsa
nodes.text: Her flock goes straight for your planeswalker.

lesson.title: Protect your walker
lesson.text: Creatures can attack planeswalkers, and flyers are hard to block. Use Elspeth's +1 to make two Soldiers (her ability doubles tokens) and keep them home as blockers. Use -3 on Ilsa's best flyer, and Day of Judgment when her board outgrows yours: it doesn't touch Elspeth.

tips.title: Loyalty first
tips.text: Elspeth starts at 5. +1 makes two Soldiers and raises her to 6. Keep her out of reach of the flyers' total power.

tips.title: Spirits
tips.text: Kykar makes a 1/1 flying Spirit each time Ilsa casts a noncreature spell. Its mana value is 3, so Elspeth's -3 can destroy it; do it before the flock grows.

tips.title: Reset
tips.text: Day of Judgment destroys every creature but leaves Elspeth. Next turn her +1 rebuilds your board first.

nodes.before: Your walker looks lonely down there. We'll keep her company.

nodes.name: Two walkers
nodes.text: Your opponent is at 9 life, and Herald of Eternal Dawn says they can't lose the game. You have Elspeth and Ajani. Win this turn.
nodes.hint: Elspeth's -3 destroys Herald of Eternal Dawn. Ajani's -3 gives Serra Angel double strike. Attack with both flyers.

lesson.title: Removal you don't have to draw
lesson.text: A planeswalker's minus ability is removal that's already on the battlefield. Elspeth's -3 is your only answer to the Herald here, and Ajani's -3 belongs on your biggest flyer, where double strike adds the most damage.

nodes.name: Warlord Brisa Vane
nodes.text: Her angels attack twice and aim for your walker.

lesson.title: Extra combats
lesson.text: Aurelia, the Warleader untaps Brisa's creatures and gives her a second combat the first time she attacks each turn, and her flyers go for Elspeth. Use Elspeth's -3 on Aurelia when you can, keep Soldiers back to block, and clear a wide board with Day of Judgment. She starts at 30 life.

tips.title: Two combats
tips.text: Aurelia has haste and doubles her combats. Destroy it before it attacks again: Elspeth's -3, Banishing Light or Stroke of Midnight.

tips.title: Guard the walker
tips.text: Block the attackers aimed at Elspeth with your Soldiers. A walker that survives makes two more every turn.

tips.title: Two combats' worth
tips.text: Count her attackers twice: Aurelia's second combat untaps them. Keep enough blockers to survive both.

nodes.before: My host strikes twice. Your walker falls once.
nodes.after: One combat too few. Well fought.

chapters.name: The meta
chapters.text: These are commanders Standard Brawl players build today, from Draftsim's Standard Brawl guide: Tifa's landfall, Aang's flash tempo, The Seriema's legends, Laughing Jasper Flint's stolen cards, Roxanne's ramp and Anim Pakal's gnomes.

nodes.name: Kesh Emberroot
nodes.text: Her meteors fall every time she attacks.

lesson.title: Tifa: land, then double
lesson.text: Tifa Lockhart has trample and doubles her power each time a land enters under your control. Play your land before combat, and crack Evolving Wilds or Terramorphic Expanse after blockers for another doubling. Protect her with Snakeskin Veil. Roxanne ramps with Meteorite tokens that deal 2 damage; race her before her big spells land.

tips.title: Fetch after blocks
tips.text: Evolving Wilds and Terramorphic Expanse put a land onto the battlefield at instant speed. Use them after blockers to double Tifa again.

tips.title: Meteorites
tips.text: Each Meteorite deals 2 damage when it enters and taps for mana. Roxanne makes one on entering and each attack, so kill her early.

tips.title: Her big turn
tips.text: Roxanne's ramp ends in Summon: Bahamut and Overlord of the Hauntwoods. Below 12, push damage before those land.

nodes.after: You dodged the sky itself. Impressive.

nodes.name: Silas Crowe
nodes.text: He plays your cards better than you do.

lesson.title: Draw-go
lesson.text: Aang's deck acts on the opponent's turn: flash creatures, counterspells and Aang himself, who has flash and flying. Draw-go means you pass your turn with mana open and act at their end step. Counter Silas's threats, flash Aang in when he's tapped out, and tap out only when nothing of his matters.

tips.title: Counter what matters
tips.text: Save counterspells for his commander, his dragons and his removal on Aang. Let small creatures resolve.

tips.title: Your cards, his hand
tips.text: Jasper exiles cards from the top of your library every upkeep and lets Silas cast them. Bounce or answer Jasper quickly.

tips.title: End-step Aang
tips.text: Cast Aang at the end of his turn: it dodges his sorcery-speed removal and attacks on yours.

nodes.before: Your library is my library. Thanks for sharing.
nodes.after: Couldn't steal what you never tapped out for.

nodes.name: Rowan Thornfield
nodes.text: Her fist gets twice as heavy with every land.

lesson.title: Station and legends
lesson.text: The Seriema is a Spacecraft: when it enters it finds a legendary creature, and you station it by tapping your creatures to add charge counters until it's a 5/5 flyer that makes your tapped legends indestructible. Against Tifa, kill her before a land drop doubles her: Get Lost and Elspeth's -3 are your answers.

tips.title: Before the land
tips.text: Tifa doubles with each land Rowan plays. Answer her on your turn with Get Lost or Elspeth's -3, before Rowan's next land.

tips.title: Station
tips.text: Tap creatures that would sit idle to station The Seriema. Once charged it flies and protects your tapped legends.

tips.title: Trample
tips.text: Tifa tramples over chump blockers. Below 12, block with your biggest creature or remove her.

nodes.before: Every land I play, I hit twice as hard. Count them.

nodes.name: Gnomecaptain Lark
nodes.text: The final: best of three against the gnome army.
nodes.sideboard: Brawl has no sideboard: your 60 cards are your 60 cards. Between games, change how you play instead. Mulligan hands with no removal against Anim Pakal, and save Epic Downfall and Hero's Downfall for Anim Pakal, Elspeth and Overlord of the Mistmoors.

lesson.title: The final
lesson.text: Laughing Jasper Flint is midrange: removal for their threats, then extra cards from the top of their library every upkeep. Anim Pakal makes tapped, attacking Gnomes every time Lark attacks and grows each time. Kill Anim Pakal early, keep blockers for the swarm, and answer their Elspeth before her Soldiers double. Two wins graduate you.

tips.title: Kill the captain
tips.text: Every attack adds a counter and more Gnomes. Hero's Downfall or Murder it now; each recast costs Lark 2 more.

tips.title: Attack the walker
tips.text: Their Elspeth doubles tokens and her -3 kills your best creature. Attack her or remove her with Hero's Downfall.

tips.title: The swarm
tips.text: Gnomes enter tapped and attacking, so count them as attackers next turn too. Below 10, keep blockers home.

nodes.before: My gnomes are small. My gnomes are many. My gnomes are coming.
nodes.after: Fewer gnomes than I thought. Well played.
